title: A New Generalization of the Class of r-Ideals in Commutative Rings
content: We introduce and systematically develop the theory of r-sdf-absorbing ideals of commutative rings, a new square-difference generalization governed by zero-divisors. We establish structural criteria relating r-sdf-absorbing ideals to r-ideals, sdf-absorbing and Nil-sdf-absorbing ideals, including an exact coincidence criterion when 2 is invertible. We characterize rings in which every proper ideal, or only the zero ideal, has this property, determine fundamental closure phenomena, and obtain comprehensive transfer results under homomorphisms, quotients, localizations, direct products, idealizations, and amalgamations. Sharp ascent and descent criteria, together with counterexamples, reveal the role of zero-divisor structure throughout.
